prompt: A costume-department armour turnaround sheet for a big-budget live-action historical war film: ONE complete suit of armour with its helmet, shown four times side by side in one row at the same scale and the same height, from left to right: seen from the FRONT, from the BACK, from ITS LEFT SIDE in strict profile, from ITS RIGHT SIDE in strict profile. The first attached picture is the style reference of this costume department (rendering, light, materials, accuracy only). The second attached picture shows this armour on its stand: take its colours, materials and construction where they agree with the description.
